description: Create a mint-open trigger. DEFAULTS TO alert_only: Oracle watches, notifies, and prepares a signable artifact. Firing unattended requires ALL of: actionMode set to the exact string 'execute', ORACLE_AUTONOMOUS_TRADING=1, and a bounded grant naming this exact contract/chain with maxTotalGasWei, maxValueWei, and an expiry under 24h. Any missing or mismatched bound silently downgrades to alert_only and says so. Even an armed trigger produces an unsigned artifact.

actionMode.description: Default alert_only. Only the exact string 'execute' can arm, and only with a grant.

grant.description: Required for execute: { contract, chainId, maxTotalGasWei, maxValueWei, expiresAt }.

name: nft_mint_trigger
